## What's Changed
* Fix TRX logger mangling astral-plane (non-BMP) characters by @​azat-msft in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16318
* Disable the MTP testhost by default by @​nohwnd in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16337
* Fix OS-blind apphost probe in MTP bridge on Unix (regression from #​16201) by @​azat-msft in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16336
* Retarget the MTP client onto Microsoft.Testing.Platform.ServerMode.Client.Sources by @​nohwnd in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16300
* Pass arguments to PowerShell with -File instead of -command by @​nohwnd in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16363
* Respect console logger verbosity from a settings file by @​nohwnd in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16044
* Fix backslash normalization in VSTestCLIRunSettings on Unix by @​nohwnd in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/15795
* Docs: fix typo explicitely -> explicitly by @​vaibhav8a in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16397
* Copy acceptance test diagnostic logs into the test results directory by @​nohwnd in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16403

## New Contributors
* @​vaibhav8a made their first contribution in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16397

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/compare/v18.10.1...v18.11.0
